title: DEF CON 23 - Charlie Miller & Chris Valasek - Remote Exploitation of an Unaltered Passenger Vehicle
summary: Charlie Miller and Chris Valasek present their DEF CON 23 talk on remotely compromising an unmodified Jeep, pivoting from the entertainment system to the vehicle's internal networks to send control messages. They aim to show the reality of car hacking.
why: HN uses it as the canonical reference that modern connected cars can be attacked remotely.

quote.text: the software architecture of the Tesla was light-years ahead of what Jeep
